#!/bin/sh
# gamedash-managed Core Keeper server — generated by provision().
# World and settings: <ROOT>/installs/corekeeper/gamedash-servers/test
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
cd "<ROOT>/installs/corekeeper/gamedash-servers/test" || exit 1
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$LD_LIBRARY_PATH:<ROOT>/installs/corekeeper/linux64/"
# The server needs a display to start; xvfb-run gives it an invisible one.
exec xvfb-run -a -s "-screen 0 1x1x24 -nolisten tcp" "<ROOT>/installs/corekeeper/CoreKeeperServer" -batchmode -logfile "<ROOT>/installs/corekeeper/gamedash-servers/test/server.log" \
    -datapath "<ROOT>/installs/corekeeper/gamedash-servers/test" -world 0 -worldname "Test World" -worldmode Normal \
    -maxplayers 8 -password "$GAME_SERVER_PASSWORD"
